title: Retain a valid held-out residual design and its unsuccessful matched comparison
statement: On seven fresh synthetic settings,500000 starts each,a fixed100000/400000 pilot/validation split supports exact count-only residual confidence by grouping correlated terms from each table. Conditional on pilot selection,weighted Hoeffding bounds the fitted observable residual; positive lower margins and exact causal normalization give the same full-law deployment contract. The matched full-data interval method was stronger on these same fresh counts.
